name: ThingsBoard
tagline: Open-source IoT platform REST API for devices, telemetry, rules, and dashboards
description: ThingsBoard is an open-source IoT platform providing REST APIs to manage devices, assets, customers, telemetry, attributes, alarms, rule chains, and dashboards. Developers can self-host the Community Edition or use ThingsBoard Cloud / Professional Edition. Auth is JWT-based (login for a token, then Bearer auth); tenant/device credentials and optional API keys apply depending on deployment.

auth.details: POST /api/auth/login with username/password returns JWT; send as X-Authorization: Bearer $JWT (or Authorization). Device APIs may use access tokens. Self-host and cloud.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Community Edition free self-host; Cloud free trial/limited plan — verify current cloud limits on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: ThingsBoard Cloud and PE paid tiers; self-host PE licenses

use_cases: login and obtain JWT for ThingsBoard REST API
list tenant devices and their credentials
post or query device telemetry timeseries
manage dashboards and rule chains via REST
